pages.title: Launch Package
pages.text: The Martian relay does not deliver a turnkey escape vehicle. It gives you the component plan and expects you to finish the launch yourself.$(br2)Everything in this entry is tied to the $(bold)ORSA blast pit$(). Build there or do not build at all.

pages.title: ORSA Launch Pad
pages.text: One craft yields $(bold)9 launch pads$() — exactly enough for the full blast-pit platform. Build the entire 3x3 pad on the blast-pit mount before you start stacking rocket parts.

pages.title: Pad Placement
pages.text: $(li)Find the designated ORSA blast pit$(li)Lay a full $(bold)3x3$() launch pad on its mount$(li)The rocket engine sits $(bold)one block above the pad center$()$(li)If the pad is off-center, the structure will not lock$(br2)This is not a decorative build. The blast trench alignment under the center plate has to stay intact.

pages.title: Rocket Engine
pages.text: The engine is the base of the rocket and must occupy the centerline over the blast pit. Place it first. Everything else builds upward from here.

pages.title: Rocket Fin
pages.text: Craft $(bold)4 fins$(). They mount on the four cardinal sides of the engine: north, south, east, and west.

pages.title: Rocket Hull
pages.text: Craft $(bold)4 hull blocks$(). Stack all four directly above the engine to form the rocket body.

pages.title: Rocket Nose Cone
pages.text: Finish the stack with the nose cone. The Acheronite Compass is consumed in the build — ORSA apparently considered that an acceptable trade.

pages.title: Final Stack
pages.text: $(li)Engine on the pad center$(li)4 fins on the engine's sides$(li)4 hull blocks stacked above the engine$(li)Nose cone on top$(br2)Once the structure locks, load $(bold)6 Rocket Fuel Cells$(), board the vehicle, and arm the launch from inside the cockpit.
